name: Shoulder to Shoulder (Combat, Teamwork)
body:
Your aid in battle is always effective.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1 or Dexterity 13

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an adjacent ally threaten the same creature you both gain the benefits of flanking that creature.
